name: Singapore Institute of Management (SIM Global Education)
summary: Singapore school delivering partner universities’ degrees (Buffalo, Stirling, London, RMIT, Wollongong); many are top-ups for diploma holders.

ib.text: Entry rules belong to each partner. Buffalo asks school grades equal to about IB 4.5; Stirling takes the IB Diploma into Year 1; RMIT and Wollongong list A-levels and diplomas, other qualifications case by case.

programmes.name: Communication
programmes.about: A University at Buffalo degree taught at SIM on interpersonal communication with an international focus, covering mass media, organisational and mediated communication and intercultural communication.
programmes.ib: Last 3 years of school at about IB 4.5 average; English: IB English A Lang & Lit grade 5, or IELTS 6.5. 30+ IB points can earn up to 30 credit exemptions.

needs.note: Or IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 79 or equivalent

programmes.selectionNote: Admitted on school grades equal to about IB 4.5 and an English test or IB English; no interview is published. Open for the January and August 2027 intakes.

flagshipSource.title: SIM GE: University at Buffalo BA (Communication), awarded by Buffalo and taught at SIM

programmes.name: Marketing
programmes.about: A University of Stirling marketing degree taught at SIM with a digital focus, practising on industry platforms such as Google Analytics and HubSpot; accredited by the Chartered Institute of Marketing.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma enters Year 1 (3-year route); related diploma holders may enter Year 2. A 3-month preparatory course may be required.
programmes.selectionNote: Admitted if you hold the IB Diploma or equivalent; no ranking or interview is published. Dates on the programme page are for the 3-year route.

flagshipSource.title: SIM GE: University of Stirling BA (Honours) Marketing, AACSB-accredited school and CIM-accredited programme

faculties.name: University at Buffalo (USA)
faculties.line: School grades near IB 4.5, English A Lang & Lit grade 5 or IELTS 6.5; 30+ IB points earn up to 30 credits.

faculties.name: University of Stirling (UK)
faculties.line: IB Diploma enters Year 1; related diploma holders can enter Year 2, sometimes after a 3-month preparatory course.

faculties.name: University of London (UK)
faculties.line: London’s general entrance rules apply; IB English at grade 4 or better meets its English requirement.

faculties.name: RMIT University (Australia)
faculties.line: Lists A-levels and polytechnic diplomas; the IB and other qualifications are judged case by case by RMIT.

faculties.name: University of Wollongong (Australia)
faculties.line: Lists A-levels and polytechnic diplomas, with credit exemptions by prior study; ask SIM how the IB is treated.

faculties.name: University of Birmingham (UK)
faculties.line: Top-up degrees for students who already hold a diploma, not first-year entry.

faculties.name: Cardiff University (UK)
faculties.line: Top-up degrees for students who already hold a diploma, not first-year entry.

faculties.name: University of Alberta (Canada)
faculties.line: Bachelor of Commerce (Top-up) for students who already hold a diploma, not first-year entry.

notes: The degree is awarded by the partner university, not by SIM, and each programme page carries its own dates, fees and entry rules, so check the one you want.
Fees are shown as estimated totals including 9% GST, and vary with credit exemptions; they are not yearly figures.
Buffalo is open for the January and August 2027 intakes; Stirling lists a separate 3-year route and a 2-year route with a preparatory course.
